exempt.lib/time-tracking/approval-queue.ts: Reads the pending approval queue; no time arithmetic.

exempt.lib/time-tracking/break-rule-form.ts: The break-rule form's schema and messages; the property test of settings.ts draws rules within its limits.

exempt.lib/time-tracking/clock-state-actions.ts: Server Actions that read and end the clock state.
exempt.lib/time-tracking/clock-state-events.ts: Which realtime events concern the clock.

exempt.lib/time-tracking/entry-edit-checks.ts: Server refusals of an entry edit by role and ownership.

exempt.lib/time-tracking/manual-entry-staging.t: Server staging of manual entries before validation.ts checks them.
exempt.lib/time-tracking/open-session-orgs.ts: Reads which organizations hold an open session for a person.
exempt.lib/time-tracking/pending-sessions.ts: Groups pending entries per submission for review; no time arithmetic.
exempt.lib/time-tracking/picker-actions.ts: Server Action of the job picker.
exempt.lib/time-tracking/picker-labels.ts: Headings and details of the job picker.
exempt.lib/time-tracking/picker-types.ts: Types and groups of the job picker.
exempt.lib/time-tracking/resume-activity.ts: Reads the activity to resume after a break.
exempt.lib/time-tracking/review-actions.ts: Server Actions of the approval review.
exempt.lib/time-tracking/segment-actions.ts: Server Action of a clock transition; the database records it.
exempt.lib/time-tracking/settings-actions.ts: Server Action that saves the break rule; the database applies it.

exempt.lib/time-tracking/state-client.ts: Browser fetch of the clock state.

exempt.lib/time-tracking/transition-hash.ts: Hashes a transition request for idempotency.

exempt.lib/time-tracking/types.ts: Types and labels of the time model.
